overview_description.description: Taskty is an online marketplace for simple services where you can find individuals and services agencies to finish your daily, short term tasks for your home and for your business. Services will range from translation, copywriting, graphic design to event photographing, house maintenance and private nursing.

product.name: Home Cleaning Services
product.description: Provides cleaning for residential spaces including rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas, with options for regular or deep cleaning.

product.name: Furniture and Upholstery Cleaning
product.description: Cleans upholstered furniture, carpets, and rugs using multi-stage processes including dust extraction, washing, and drying.

product.name: Pest Control Services
product.description: Offers pest elimination for homes including kitchens and bathrooms using odorless, environmentally friendly materials.

product.name: Air Conditioning Services
product.description: Includes air conditioner maintenance such as refrigerant refilling, cleaning, inspection, and installation.

product.name: Plumbing Services
